_comment: One entry per home series. `owner_ids` are resolved start.gg owner ids, all of which get passed to `collect.py --owner-id` together (results are merged/deduped) since page-creation duty tends to rotate between a few organizers on the same series.

confirmed.445861: TK1 - verified via direct start.gg account linkage (user page links gamerTag "TK1" to this id, matches owner of the TK1 Birthday Bash edition)
confirmed.520101: Drilago - verified via direct start.gg account linkage

encore_smash.note: Encore's slug pattern has also changed over time (encore-smash-weekly-N in 2020-2021 vs encore-smash-N more recently) - collect.py's owner-based discovery handles this fine since it doesn't depend on slug format.

confirmed.166752: Ryan Exists - verified via direct account linkage

unconfirmed_but_included.181535: Sean Powers - most frequent owner in recent editions, real identity vs. cba/Crimson/Smashchester not confirmed
unconfirmed_but_included.407077: Christos Bobolakis (gamerTag 'Bobo') - initials loosely match 'cba' but not verified
unconfirmed_but_included.177435: Ricky M - real identity not confirmed

undiscovered_smash.note: Chris named cba, Crimson, and Smashchester as organizers but none could be confidently matched to these 4 empirically-observed owner accounts (sampled from ~11 real editions) via web search. Included all 4 anyway since coverage matters more than knowing which tag maps to which account - if more owners turn up on editions not yet pulled, add their ids here.

back_from_the_ded.note: Retired series. Only checked against Ryan Exists (166752) so far, who does own at least some editions (e.g. Back From the DED Monthly #13). Worth re-checking against the other 3 undiscovered_smash owner ids too if a first pull looks incomplete.
